meaning:
τεταρταῖος, -α, -ον
(τέταρτος), [in LXX: 2Ki.3:4 A (רְבִיעִי) * ;]
of or on the fourth day: τ. εἶναι (Hdt., τ. γενέσθαι), to be four days dead, Jhn.11:39.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”
